column1: # Deskripsi skill — keluarga kalimat mekanik, putaran kedua.
# Nama elemen, nama karakter, dan nama status dibawa backref supaya tetap Inggris.
# --- cooldown & batas pakai ---
^This has a cooldown of (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) turns?</color>\.$
column2: Ini memiliki cooldown \1\2 giliran</color>.

column1: ^For each target hit, reduce this skill's cooldown by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) turns?</color>\.$
column2: Setiap target yang terkena, kurangi cooldown skill ini \1\2 giliran</color>.

column1: ^After this skill is used, it cannot be used again until the end of the next allied turn\.$
column2: Setelah skill ini dipakai, tidak bisa dipakai lagi sampai akhir giliran sekutu berikutnya.

column1: ^Cannot be used more than once per turn\.$
column2: Tidak bisa dipakai lebih dari sekali per giliran.

column1: ^This effect can only be triggered once per turn\.$
column2: Efek ini hanya bisa terpicu sekali per giliran.

column1: ^Can stack up to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) times</color>\.$
column2: Bisa ditumpuk hingga \1\2 kali</color>.

column1: ^This unit's Max HP is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Max HP unit ini meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Healing received is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Healing yang diterima meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Critical damage from basic attacks is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Critical Damage dari serangan dasar meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Damage dealt to PMC units is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage ke unit PMC meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^Damage dealt by this unit's physical summons is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage dari summon fisik unit ini meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^If other allied units have this effect, ignore an additional (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> of the target's defense\.$
column2: Jika unit sekutu lain memiliki efek ini, abaikan tambahan \1\2%</color> Defense target.

column1: # --- damage per elemen (varian huruf besar & bentuk lain) ---
^Increase (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) [Dd]amage</color> dealt by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Tingkatkan damage \1\2</color> yang diberikan \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^(<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) Damage</color> dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage \1\2</color> yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^(<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color> dealt by all allied units is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage \1\2</color> dari semua unit sekutu meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^All (\w+) damage dealt by allied units is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Semua damage \1 dari unit sekutu meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^(<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color> is increased by another (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage \1\2</color> meningkat lagi \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^After performing a basic attack, (\w+) damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Setelah melakukan serangan dasar, damage \1 meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^When dealing (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color>, damage boost is additionally increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat memberikan damage \1\2</color>, peningkatan damage bertambah sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^When allied units deal (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color>, critical damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat unit sekutu memberikan damage \1\2</color>, Critical Damage meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^Deals AoE (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\w+) damage</color> to all enemy units within (\d+) tiles in the selected direction\.$
column2: Memberikan damage AoE \1\2</color> ke semua unit musuh dalam \3 tile pada arah yang dipilih.

column1: ^Deals physical damage and applies (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color>\.$
column2: Memberikan damage physical dan menerapkan \1\2</color>.

column1: # --- kondisi target ---
^Damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> against targets with defense debuffs\.$
column2: Damage meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color> terhadap target dengan debuff Defense.

column1: ^Damage dealt to enemy units with (\w+) debuffs is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Damage ke unit musuh dengan debuff \1 meningkat sebesar \2\3%</color>.

column1: ^Damage dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> against enemy targets with (\w+) debuffs\.$
column2: Damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color> terhadap target musuh dengan debuff \3.

column1: ^Increases damage by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color> to enemy units with full HP or a lower HP percentage than the user\.$
column2: Damage ke unit musuh ber-HP penuh atau berpersentase HP lebih rendah dari pengguna meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^If they have a Shield effect, damage dealt is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika mereka memiliki efek Shield, damage yang diberikan meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^If HP is above (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>, out-of-turn damage is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika HP di atas \1\2%</color>, damage di luar giliran meningkat sebesar \3\4%</color>.

column1: ^If there is a target with (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color> on the battlefield, this attack prioritizes that target\.$
column2: Jika ada target ber-\1\2</color> di medan perang, serangan ini memprioritaskan target itu.

column1: ^If a (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color> is already on the field, teleports it to the selected tile instead\.$
column2: Jika \1\2</color> sudah ada di medan, dia dipindahkan ke tile yang dipilih.

column1: ^If the attack kills the enemy target, (\w+) gains (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color>\.$
column2: Jika serangan ini mengalahkan target musuh, \1 mendapatkan \2\3</color>.

column1: ^If there is no Cover near the target, deals (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color> of stability damage to the target before the attack\.$
column2: Jika tidak ada Cover di dekat target, berikan \1\2 poin</color> damage Stability ke target sebelum serangan.

column1: # --- buff/debuff berantai ---
^When applying a debuff, the damage of the next active skill is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat menerapkan debuff, damage skill aktif berikutnya meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When applying a buff to an allied target, increases damage dealt by the next active skill by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat menerapkan buff ke target sekutu, damage skill aktif berikutnya meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When applying a buff to an allied target, increases damage dealt by the next attack by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Saat menerapkan buff ke target sekutu, damage serangan berikutnya meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^After applying a buff to an allied target, increase healing and damage dealt by the next effect by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Setelah menerapkan buff ke target sekutu, healing dan damage efek berikutnya meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: ^When actively healing a target, applies (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color> to the target for (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) turns?</color>\.$
column2: Saat menyembuhkan target secara aktif, menerapkan \1\2</color> ke target selama \3\4 giliran</color>.

column1: ^If an active skill does not deal damage, critical damage dealt by the next attack is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika skill aktif tidak memberikan damage, Critical Damage serangan berikutnya meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.

column1: # --- stability ---
^Regains all points of stability (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) turns?</color> after entering Stability Break\.$
column2: Memulihkan seluruh poin Stability \1\2 giliran</color> setelah masuk Stability Break.

column1: ^During Stability Break, whenever stability is recovered, additionally restores (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+) points?</color> of stability index\.$
column2: Selama Stability Break, setiap kali Stability pulih, tambahan \1\2 poin</color> Stability Index dipulihkan.

column1: ^When the user's stability index is greater than (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)</color>, maintain (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)(\{\d+\})</color>\.$
column2: Saat Stability Index pengguna lebih dari \1\2</color>, pertahankan \3\4</color>.

column1: # --- multiplier ---
^Damage multiplier is increased to (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d+ .]+)%</color> of Precision value\.$
column2: Damage multiplier naik menjadi \1\2%</color> dari Precision value.

column1: # Sumber kalimat berikut rusak di aslinya (kata "damage" hilang):
# "If an attack exploits a weakness is increased by X%." — diterjemahkan sesuai
# maksud yang jelas dari kalimat sejenis di deskripsi lain.
^If an attack exploits a weakness is increased by (<color=#[0-9a-fA-F]+>)([\d.]+)%</color>\.$
column2: Jika serangan mengeksploitasi kelemahan, damage meningkat sebesar \1\2%</color>.
